investment_policy_en:
Strategy: The Portfolio Manager has a disciplined, bottom-up contrarian value approach, looking for out of favour stocks which are significantly mispriced due to structural and/or cyclical concerns. The Portfolio Manager seeks to exploit the broadest opportunity set by taking both long and short positions.The fund is run in an unconstrained, high conviction manner. New positions in the long book will typically exhibit a contrarian/value bias, where sentiment is overly negative relative to the fundamentals of the business.

The portfolio’s short book will primarily focus on broken business models, weak balance sheets and poor management. The manager also seeks alpha through dynamic management of individual stock positions in a counter-cyclical way. The typical range for net market exposure is 90-110% of fund TNA under normal market circumstances.

The fund also maintains higher active share levels than a long-only equivalent.

Objective: The fund aims to achieve capital growth over the long term.

Investment Policy: The fund invests at least 70% of its assets in equities of, and related instruments providing exposure to, companies throughout the world, including emerging markets.

The fund may invest in the following assets up to the percentages indicated:

Emerging markets: up to 50%

Money market instruments: up to 20%
